column1: # The modules of nvn_mtl.m in extraction order (agents/refactor/plan.md, Modules): each calls only modules above it in this list.

column3: concern
diagnostic plumbing every module may call: CPU profile, wait and boot stats, A/B phases, GPU frame tags, passdump, the hook table
Metal device and queues, residency, host libraries, hot switches
stateless texture-format helpers
the encode-thread recorder and the uniform-copy thread
fences, completion, waits, deferred release, post-ops, queries and conditional rendering, the submission serial
the Metal 4 compiler, binary archives, library files
memory pools, guest-to-Metal addresses, per-submission arenas
object-id maps and the serial table, aliases, ghosts
the shader map, function loading and specialisation, programs, builtins
the draw state S, the pass state R, g_pass, save / restore, the replay cursor
write tracking (pending writes, epochs), uniform patch lookups, GPU-written memory
the open command buffer and encoders, the enc_* wrappers, argument-table filters, the copy and compute encoder, buffer copy / fill / update, deferred inline updates
the upload batch, zero and initial fills, old-queue synchronisation
sparse textures and tiles
vertex input: buffers, formats, conversions, pull layouts
host textures for guest textures: creation, upgrade, packages, CPU-written and linear textures, mirror readbacks
pipeline keys, descriptors, builds, pending builds, hybrids, depth-stencil states, the compute pipeline cache
the descriptor registry (textures, images, samplers), views, texel buffers, finalisation
tile-memory optimisations: store lookahead, attachment ledger, zero-source skip
render passes and their encoder state machine, segments, allocators
present queue, display link and pacing, MetalFX, snapshots, streaming
index, indirect and multi-draw conversions
argument encoding (encode_args_)
copies, clears, lazy clears, texel readbacks, DLSS
prepare, shader and pipeline prewarm, prebuild, predicted pipelines
pass dumps and reports behind the hook table
replay rewrites: deferred draws, pass fusion, hoists, load elision
frame capture
geometry emulation, mesh draws, transform feedback
the draw and dispatch ops (draw_, dispatch, image_prepare)
one submission: mtl_sub_begin, the op loop mtl_exec, mtl_sub_commit, mtl_submit
what stays in nvn_mtl.m: mtl_init as the composition root, a few public wrappers
